snippet.title: Two Little Words That Make Everyone Smile 😊 Say Thank You! | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Do you know two little words that make everyone smile? Thank you!

Our beloved Prophet Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) said: "Whoever does not thank people, does not thank Allah."

Say thank you when Mummy makes your food, and when a friend shares a toy. You can also say Jazak Allahu khayran: may Allah reward you with good. And say Alhamdulillah to thank Allah for everything.

Who will your little one thank today?

Source
• Jami' at-Tirmidhi 1954 (Hasan Sahih): https://sunnah.com/tirmidhi:1954
